title: cheilanthes odora proles maderensis
intro: Cheilanthes odora proles maderensis, commonly known as Madeiran Lip fern, is a rare and endangered species of fern native to the island of Madeira, Portugal. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. Cheilanthes odora proles maderensis has been traditionally used to treat respiratory problems, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties, and its therapeutic actions include antiseptic and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
